name: @lovenndme/dsh-workspace-memory
description: Workspace-scoped persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness, laid out like Claude Code's memory: English-slug memory files flat beside a MEMORY.md index under ~/.dsh/projects/<encoded-workspace>/memory/, with hybrid vector + keyword recall (vectors stay in process memory, nothing derived is written to disk).
author: Lovenndme

compatibility.note: Host + Client halves. Host: ctx.tools.register, ctx.commands.register, ctx.sessions, ctx.workingDirectory, ctx.systemPrompt.context, ctx.webServer.register. Client: conversation.chat.commandview (keys memory/memory_list) and sidebar.right.pane.tab. leanvec is an optionalDependency resolved at runtime; when unavailable the plugin degrades to keyword-only recall and says so instead of failing. Tunables come from the row's config (no schemastery schema, so Settings does not render a form); validation problems surface through memory_status.
